name: Hexagon Nutrition
aiSummary: Strong fundamentals with growing nutrition market. Company has shown consistent revenue growth of 22% YoY. Peer comparison favorable against listed nutrition companies.
description: Hexagon Nutrition is India's leading clinical and sports nutrition company. They manufacture protein supplements, clinical nutrition products (for hospitals), and maternal nutrition. The company supplies to 60+ countries and owns brands like Pureprotein and Hexagrow. They are the largest contract manufacturer of nutritional supplements in India.
purpose: Expansion of manufacturing capacity at Nashik plant, new product R&D, international market expansion (Africa, SEA), brand building, and working capital requirements.

name: CMR Green Technologies
aiSummary: Positioned in the booming green energy sector with government tailwinds. Strong order book provides revenue visibility for next 2 years.
description: CMR Green Technologies is a renewable energy EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) company specializing in solar power plants, wind energy projects, and green hydrogen. They execute utility-scale solar projects for government and private clients. The company has completed 2.5 GW of solar installations across 12 states and has a current order book of ₹2,400 Cr.
purpose: Execution of existing order book, expansion into green hydrogen segment, setting up solar module manufacturing unit (500 MW capacity), and debt repayment.

name: Genxai Analytics
aiSummary: Small AI analytics firm with niche offerings. Revenue is growing but profitability margins are thin. High competition in the AI services space.
description: Genxai Analytics provides AI/ML-based data analytics solutions to mid-size enterprises. Their core product is an analytics platform that helps companies analyze customer behavior, predict churn, and optimize marketing spend. They serve clients in BFSI, e-commerce, and healthcare sectors with 35+ enterprise customers.
purpose: Product development (NLP and computer vision modules), hiring data scientists, sales team expansion, and cloud infrastructure investments.

name: Vahh Chemicals
aiSummary: Chemical company with inconsistent financial track record. Negative GMP signals market skepticism. Valuations appear stretched compared to sector peers.
description: Vahh Chemicals manufactures specialty chemicals and intermediates used in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and dye industries. They operate a single manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar GIDC, Gujarat. Revenue has been inconsistent due to raw material price volatility and dependency on a few large customers.
purpose: Capacity expansion of existing plant, setting up effluent treatment facility, repayment of term loans, and working capital.

name: Bagmane Prime Office
aiSummary: India's premium office REIT with Grade A properties in Bangalore. Stable rental yields but limited capital appreciation potential in current market.
description: Bagmane Prime Office is a REIT (Real Estate Investment Trust) that owns and manages premium Grade A office spaces in Bangalore's tech corridors. The portfolio includes 15 million sq ft of office space leased to top IT companies including Microsoft, Cisco, Wells Fargo, and Goldman Sachs. Occupancy rate is 93% with weighted average lease expiry of 5.2 years.
purpose: Acquisition of additional office assets from sponsor (Bagmane Group), debt reduction, and distribution to unitholders.

name: OnEMI Technology Solutions
aiSummary: Leading BNPL player (Kissht brand) with strong digital lending platform. Growth is impressive but regulatory risks in digital lending space persist.
description: OnEMI Technology Solutions operates 'Kissht', one of India's largest Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and personal loan platforms. They provide instant credit to underserved consumers using AI-based credit scoring. The platform has 25M+ registered users, ₹8,000 Cr annual disbursement, and partners with 5,000+ merchants. They are RBI-registered NBFC.
purpose: Augmenting capital base for loan book growth, technology infrastructure, regulatory compliance reserves, and brand marketing.

name: Bajaj Housing Finance
description: Bajaj Housing Finance is a housing finance company and subsidiary of Bajaj Finance. It offers home loans, loan against property, lease rental discounting, and developer finance. AUM exceeds ₹90,000 Cr with strong asset quality (GNPA < 0.3%).
purpose: Meeting capital adequacy requirements for growth, expanding loan book, and regulatory compliance.

name: Ola Electric
description: Ola Electric is India largest electric two-wheeler manufacturer. They operate the Ola Futurefactory (world largest 2W factory) and sell S1, S1 Pro, S1 Air, and S1 X scooters. Also developing electric cars and batteries (Ola Gigafactory).
purpose: Battery cell manufacturing (Gigafactory), R&D for new vehicles, expanding charging network, and working capital.

name: FirstCry (Brainbees)
description: FirstCry is India largest online platform for baby and kids products. They operate 1,000+ stores across India and international markets. Also runs BabyHug (private label), Intellitots (preschools), and GlobalBees (D2C brands).
purpose: Store expansion, technology investment, working capital, and potential acquisitions.

name: Swiggy
founders: Sriharsha Majety, Nandan Reddy, Rahul Jaimini
description: Swiggy is India second-largest food delivery platform (after Zomato). Also operates Instamart (grocery delivery), Dineout (restaurant reservations), and Genie (courier service). Serves 500+ cities with 200K+ restaurant partners.
purpose: Expanding quick commerce (Instamart), technology infrastructure, dark store network, and reducing losses.

name: NTPC Green Energy
description: NTPC Green Energy is the renewable energy arm of NTPC (India largest power company). Focused on solar, wind, and green hydrogen projects. Target 60 GW renewable capacity by 2032. Government-backed with strong project pipeline.
purpose: Setting up renewable energy projects, green hydrogen plants, and battery energy storage systems.

name: Hyundai Motor India
description: Hyundai Motor India is India second-largest car manufacturer (after Maruti). Sells Creta, Venue, i20, Tucson, Verna, and Ioniq 5 EV. Annual sales 750K+ units. Revenue ₹70,000+ Cr. India is Hyundai global manufacturing hub for exports.
purpose: Expanding manufacturing capacity, EV lineup development, and strengthening distribution network.

name: Afcons Infrastructure
description: Afcons Infrastructure is one of India largest infrastructure EPC companies. Builds bridges, tunnels, marine structures, highways, and metro systems. Operates in 20+ countries. Part of the Shapoorji Pallonji Group.
purpose: Funding equipment purchases, working capital for large projects, and expansion into new geographies.

name: Manba Finance
description: Manba Finance is an NBFC providing two-wheeler and used car loans, primarily in rural and semi-urban India. Focus on underserved borrowers with limited credit history. AUM ₹1,200+ Cr.
purpose: Augmenting capital base for loan book growth, branch expansion, and technology upgrades.

name: Deepak Builders
description: Deepak Builders is a construction company focused on residential and commercial projects in Gujarat.
purpose: New project land acquisition and working capital.

name: Sahaj Solar
description: Sahaj Solar manufactures solar panels and provides rooftop solar EPC solutions for commercial and industrial clients in India.
purpose: Manufacturing capacity expansion and working capital.

name: Vraj Iron & Steel
description: Vraj Iron & Steel manufactures sponge iron, TMT bars, and steel billets. Integrated steel plant with captive power generation.
purpose: Capacity expansion and modernization of steel plant.

name: Jyoti CNC Automation
description: Jyoti CNC Automation is India largest CNC machine manufacturer. Makes turning centers, machining centers, and special purpose machines for automotive, aerospace, and defense sectors. Exports to 40+ countries.
purpose: R&D for 5-axis machines, capacity expansion, and international market development.

name: Hexaware Technologies
description: Hexaware Technologies is a global IT services company specializing in automation, cloud, and digital transformation. Serves BFSI, healthcare, and manufacturing sectors. 30,000+ employees across 30 countries. Revenue USD 1.2B+.
purpose: Offer for sale by Carlyle Group (PE exit). No fresh issue component.

name: Laxmi Dental
description: Laxmi Dental is India largest dental products manufacturer and dental lab. Makes crowns, bridges, aligners, implants, and dental equipment. Serves 22,000+ dental clinics across India.
purpose: Setting up new dental labs, expanding aligner business, and equipment modernization.

name: Quality Power Electrical
description: Quality Power Electrical manufactures transformers, switchgears, and electrical equipment for power transmission and distribution. Supplies to state electricity boards and private power companies.
purpose: Capacity expansion, new manufacturing lines, and working capital.

name: Stallion India Fluorochemicals
description: Stallion India Fluorochemicals imports and distributes refrigerant gases used in air conditioning and refrigeration. Leading supplier of R-32, R-410A, and R-134a gases in India.
purpose: Expanding storage infrastructure, working capital, and new product segments.

name: Merritronix
description: Merritronix is an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company making PCBs, LED lighting, and IoT devices for OEM clients.
purpose: New manufacturing facility, working capital, and R&D.

name: Rajnandini Fashion
description: Rajnandini Fashion India manufactures and exports ethnic wear sarees and dress materials through online and offline channels.
purpose: Brand building, inventory expansion, and new retail outlets.

name: SMR Jewels
description: SMR Jewels is a retail jewellery chain operating in South India specializing in gold, diamond, and silver jewellery.
purpose: New store openings and working capital for inventory.

name: Yaashvi Jewellers
description: Yaashvi Jewellers manufactures and retails gold and diamond jewellery through own stores in Gujarat.
purpose: Store expansion and inventory buildup.

name: UHM Vacation
aiSummary: Small hospitality company offering vacation ownership and timeshare products. Early stage with limited revenue visibility. Low subscription indicates cautious market sentiment.
description: UHM Vacation provides vacation ownership (timeshare) and holiday membership plans. They operate resorts and tie-ups with hotels across India for their members. The company targets middle-income families seeking affordable holiday packages.
purpose: Resort property acquisition, marketing expenses, and working capital.
